# Aure Chemical

> > Aure Chemical is a global chemical supplier based in Shandong, China, specializing in high-purity organic chemicals, pharmaceutical intermediates, and industrial bulk solutions.

Founded in 2014, Aure Chemical supplies fine chemicals and pharmaceutical intermediates to industries across Europe, Asia, and Australia. The company provides comprehensive solutions including chemical supply chain management, export logistics, and a diverse product catalog ranging from hydrocarbons and aromatics to specialty chemicals.

## Core Products & Catalogs

- [Industrial Raw Chemicals & Bulk Supply Solutions](https://aurechem.com/products.html): Industrial raw chemicals: benzene, cyclohexane, bulk supply solutions
- [Organic Chemicals](https://aurechem.com/organic-chemicals.html): Organic chemicals: hydrocarbons, aromatics, alcohols, ethers, intermediates
- [Hydrocarbons](https://aurechem.com/hydrocarbons.html): Hydrocarbons: cyclohexane, cyclopentane, isooctane, high-purity solvents
- [Aromatics](https://aurechem.com/aromatics.html): Aromatics: benzene, xylenes, styrene monomer, high-purity products
- [Alcohols](https://aurechem.com/alcohols.html): Alcohols: methanol, ethanol, isopropyl alcohol, industrial & lab grades
- [Ethers](https://aurechem.com/ethers.html): Ethers: MTBE, tetrahydrofuran, anisole, pharmaceutical-grade solvents
- [Esters](https://aurechem.com/esters.html): Esters: ethyl acetate, methyl acetate, dimethyl carbonate, solvents
- [Carboxylic Acids](https://aurechem.com/carboxylic-acids.html): Carboxylic acids: acetic, formic, trifluoroacetic, pharmaceutical synthesis

## Specialty & Intermediate Chemicals

- [Chlorinated Aromatics](https://aurechem.com/chlorinated-aromatics.html): Chlorinated aromatics: dichlorobenzene, chlorotoluene, specialty chemicals
- [Aldehydes](https://aurechem.com/aldehydes.html): Aldehydes: formaldehyde, butyraldehyde, industrial & reagent grades
- [Ketones](https://aurechem.com/ketones.html): Ketones: cyclohexanone, hexafluoroacetone, high-purity solvents
- [Acyl Halides](https://aurechem.com/acyl-halides.html): Acyl halides: propionyl chloride, benzoyl chloride, synthesis intermediates
- [Anhydrides](https://aurechem.com/anhydrides.html): Anhydrides: maleic, phthalic, methacrylic, specialty chemical products
